notes:
• New Inventory tab (Ctrl+8, next to Card sorting) with two sections:
• 🔄 Reprice: pull cards off the shelf and 📠 Scan cards to reprice → ⚡ Send to CardUploader → export the CSV. It loads by itself, every SKU is found in Square and you see the Square price, stock, today's market and the new price (market + your label markup & rounding) with the change in $ and %. Cards that moved at least 5% and $0.25 are ticked (change the limits; type your own price on any card). Update prices in Square changes them all at once, then print new stickers for them
• Cards from the scan that aren't in Square: one click moves them to Add to Square
• ➕ Add to Square (no offer): scan cards the store already owns that aren't in Square → they're created in Square with price, stock and picture — no offer, no cost. Cards already in Square are left unticked (ticking adds to their stock). Print stickers right after
• You can also drop or load any CardUploader / TCGplayer / Collectr CSV into either section; the lists are kept until you clear them
